scope: Independent fabricated mathematical, source/lifecycle and memory qualification only. No canonical observations, historical candidate data or truth enters these cases.

fixed_base_point.transform: Natural first6 values are logged once to construct the original chart.

fixed_cases.name: zero_current_signed_jet
fixed_cases.check: Independent full16D second-order AD against the C prepared row; tau decay and H*h0 retained; unexcited gamma derivatives exactly absent.

fixed_cases.name: positive_current_signed_jet
fixed_cases.check: All signed first/second derivatives and structural sparsity; inactive gamma_minus entries absent.

fixed_cases.name: negative_current_signed_jet
fixed_cases.check: All signed first/second derivatives and structural sparsity; inactive gamma_plus entries absent.

fixed_cases.name: mixed_current_signed_jet
fixed_cases.check: All20 lower Hessian pairs including cross-rate hysteresis and H*h0, original dt/order and prospective-versus-committed jet consistency.

fixed_cases.name: zero_H_boundary_h_signed_jet
fixed_cases.check: At H=0,h0=1 the H*h0 cross derivative remains present even when the first h0 derivative vanishes. No h clipping or division by H.

fixed_cases.name: independent_directional_finite_difference
fixed_cases.check: Five-point first and second directional differences of an independent scalar physical recurrence at the mixed fixture endpoint cross-check the AD oracle in exactly2 fixed directions. h=2^-7; direction1 scales*(i+1)/16, direction2 scales*(-1)^i*(17-i)/16, zero-based i.

fixed_cases.name: affine_QR_objective
fixed_cases.check: Affine restriction matches direct residual sums, full gradient and Hessian at3 fixed query displacements; prepared physical rows also exercise the actual C QR insertion.

fixed_cases.name: signed_sparse_quadratic_QR_objective
fixed_cases.check: A fixed fabricated triangular factor with all20 signed quadratic monomials matches independently expanded residual cost, gradient and true Hessian at3 fixed query displacements. It must retain residual-Hessian cross terms.

fixed_cases.name: zero_and_rank_deficient_QR
fixed_cases.check: Zero and rank-deficient fabricated factors have finite correct cost/gradient/Hessian without invented precision, damping, rank cutoff or pseudoinverse.

fixed_cases.name: source_chronology_prevalidation
fixed_cases.check: Wrong source, duplicate index and skipped index reject without adding evidence or changing the operational bank; correct continuation consumes the row once.

fixed_cases.name: support_nonfinite_prevalidation
fixed_cases.check: Invalid initialization/support and nonfinite/negative-duration inputs reject according to the frozen header; no silent clipping or sample replacement.

fixed_cases.name: in_place_numerical_fault
fixed_cases.check: A declared fabricated oversized factor/row arithmetic fault either rejects before mutation or latches unavailable after mutation. Subsequent query/push/refine must not consume a partially changed factor; do not claim old-byte rollback.

fixed_cases.name: query_and_endpoint_no_evidence_duplication
fixed_cases.check: Repeated queries/endpoint projection may increment their own declared counters but never alter factor, origin, physical jet, source cursor, model-step or QR-row counts.

fixed_cases.name: exact_common_mixture_prior
fixed_cases.check: Independent second-order AD of the public whole-mixture kernel at exactly3 fixed public points (mean and two public component means) verifies cost/gradient/Hessian and distinction from curvature majorizer.

fixed_cases.name: one_bounded_fabricated_refinement
fixed_cases.check: Exactly1 call, max_rounds=2, to the C sketch refiner on a fixed strong full-rank affine likelihood centered at the public mean. Require correct frozen decrease/ownership/stop accounting, never force convergence or exact nonlinear-history acceptance.

fixed_cases.name: no_heap_and_complete_layout
fixed_cases.check: Inspect symbols, actual sizeof/offsets and compiler stack records. One operational bank only; the phase union must account for simultaneous query arrays. No malloc/calloc/realloc/free references or hidden duplicate factor. Target runtime/IRQ/caller reserves remain explicitly unmeasured.

fixed_query_displacements: Zero; 0.1*scales*((i-7.5)/8); -0.1*scales*((-1)^i)*(i+1)/16. All inputs are fabricated original-chart points, subject to raw support.
fabricated_factor: Upper triangular37x37; diagonal0.25+(row%5)/32, off-diagonal(((row+3)*(column+5))%17-8)/256. Affine variant zeroes quadratic columns; zero/rank-deficient variants remove declared rows/columns rather than alter eigenvalues.

numerical_gates.meaning: Frozen fabricated reconstruction tolerances, not production inference, voltage-accuracy, noise-calibration or uncertainty thresholds. No claim of outward-rounded libm error certification.

proposed_whole_system_ledger_bytes.status: Hard proposed allocations and host-layout checks, not measured Cortex-M23 SRAM or timing.

failure_policy: Reserve one attempt and bind plan/source/compiler/Python before tests. Preserve any failing receipt and partial outputs. A defect repair or change to fixtures/gates requires an explicit separately recorded decision; no silent retry or tolerance widening.
finish_line: One saved finite qualification and independent source review. Stop after declared cases; no new broad campaign or canonical run is authorized by this plan.
